items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: He said, 'Mitchell? My name's Red Kelly.' I'd hired the wrong Red.

ctx.x: So, we're in a car and he goes to sleep and I'm driving and driving and then I stopped to eat and he said, 'If you want me to drive, I will.' Now when I'd see Red Mitchell a few times before, I wasn't sure exactly how -- it seemed strange, but I wasn't sure. I'd seen him in a dark club over in Jersey. I knew his name and the way he sounded. So, this guy went along, and we got out, just about to Chicago and I said, 'Hey, Mitchell.' He said, 'Mitchell? My name's Red Kelly.' I'd hired the wrong Red. So we went on to…
Now we came back to town, Los Angeles, and they'd booked us into a club out in the Valley, oh a funny hat place -- So I didn't want to go in there --
